shared_elements: head or face above a torso
arms at the sides of the body
justification: The main correspondence is that both surfaces include a vertically oriented human or anthropomorphic figure with a head/headdress, torso, arms, and circular or band-like ornaments on the body. The biggest difference is that A is a highly schematic frontal body-like figure dominated by a few large abstract motifs, while B is a detailed profile standing person with elaborate costume, staff-like objects, attendant heads, and a separate vertical column of signs.
